title: Pwn2Own Berlin 2026: participants earned a total of ~$1.3M for 47 vulnerabilities, with successful exploits of AI products like Codex, Cursor, and LM Studio (Eduard Kovacs/SecurityWeek)
summary: Eduard Kovacs / SecurityWeek: Pwn2Own Berlin 2026: participants earned a total of ~$1.3M for 47 vulnerabilities, with successful exploits of AI products like Codex, Cursor, and LM Studio — Participants demonstrated exploits for Windows, Linux, VMware, Nvidia, and AI products. … Pwn2Own Berlin 2026 has come to an end …
